integrity: All-dimensions proof uses exact Walsh-character restriction ranks and positive-loss spectral separation; finite code checks are supplementary. Historical novelty and independent validation are not certified.
scientific_limitations: Only a uniform-hopping one-particle binary-hypercube walk, with strictly positive loss at every vertex of a complete product-repetition-code trap set; no finite-time decay rates or robustness to Hamiltonian disorder are asserted.
title: Geometry-independent dark spectra for block-repetition-code absorbers on quantum hypercubes
